svg.aria-label: Synchronous vs asynchronous rollout (simulated, same episode durations)
svg.text: Synchronous vs asynchronous rollout (simulated, same episode durations)
8 slots, 8 episodes per step, 60 s train, 10 s sync. Sync finishes 4 steps at 1130 s; async (eta = 1, partial rollouts) at 493 s.
Synchronous: wait for the slowest episode, then train
